text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was taking a stroll through 
town...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onii-chan! Listen to the story with 
us, Onii-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Onee-chan! Listen to the story with 
us, Onee-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~... Actually, Curren really wants to 
try going on an overseas race trip~...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You were staring at that travel ad so 
seriously. So, fulfilling my duty as a 
first-class Umamusume, I decided to reach 
out to a troubled junior!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, an overseas campaign... ...I can 
totally understand longing for that~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, the academy will 
make hotel arrangements if you apply for 
them. Fufu, then on the condition that we 
stay at a top-tier hotel—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, King, you know so much! A first-rate 
Umamusume really knows everything!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hawaa... Curren wants to sit back and hear 
a whole lot more of your stories~...♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! So you do understand! That's 
right, I am a first-rate Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll cancel my plans for later 
and dedicate myself solely to you girls! 
Let's go talk somewhere we can relax more!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah, are you really sure~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am a first-rate upperclassman, 
after all! Treating my juniors to 
delicious food is only natural♪
choice_data_list: No, I should be the one to...
No, I should be the one to...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't you worry about it either. It's 
a gift for my cute junior, after all♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Staff! Take this girl's order, please!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take a Cream Choco Latte, 
please♪

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, is there anywhere specific you want to 
go? If you have a place in mind, I could 
ask around through my connections—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Asia, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, not bad. The climate is similar, and 
there's no need to worry about jet lag. 
For a first trip overseas, it's a sensible 
choice.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, while maybe not right now, I've 
always wanted to visit Hong Kong someday."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. What a coincidence! Curren was just 
thinking how much she really wanted to go 
there too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Last time I went because I was invited, so 
I thought maybe I'd go on my own this 
time~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? "Invited before"? So this isn't 
your first time?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There was such a strong call from 
local fans wanting to meet me, so we held 
a small fan meeting for them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the local fans took care of all 
the preparations... Oh, that's right. Look 
at this photo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? Aren't there way too many fans!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In the photo Curren Chan showed me, 
there were hundreds of fans posing with 
her."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... That's amazing, isn't it... To 
think you could do something like that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But this time I'd love to go on a 
proper official away trip...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But this time I'd love to go on a 
proper official away trip...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Don't say powerful, say active, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And if we're talking powerful, King-san is 
way more powerful! Her race strategy the 
other day was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, King-san. Next time, could you not 
just tell me about overseas, but teach me 
how you train too?♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here is your Cream Choco Latte. I'll set 
it down right on this table for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Waah, looks delicious! Thank you, King♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the bombshell Curren Chan casually 
dropped held immense power, leaving an 
impact that lingered for quite some 
time...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. You think so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Things are all about timing and quick 
reflexes, though. Isn't that the same in 
racing as well?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hey... Curren-san?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so King-san thinks so too? Ehe, looks 
like fellow short-distance runners really 
hit it off♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could you tell me more about 
what you were just discussing...? Um... 
for future reference, of course.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh. Of course♪ Let's chat a bunch until 
the chocolate arrives♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, the roles of teacher 
and student had reversed. —So explosive 
power is what matters, huh...!
